festivals.what: Nachi no Ogi Matsuri (Nachi Fire Festival), the annual grand festival of Kumano Nachi Taisha: 14 July every year, with 12 fan-shaped portable shrines; preparation rites on 9, 11 and 13 July.

culture-cycles.note: Dates from the shrine, temple, organiser or city's own page, read directly 2026-11-05.
